## LLM002 Shared ChatMemory in a singleton

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | error |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://pgy763.github.io/llm-dev-pitfalls/java/多用户共用一份ChatMemory |
| Turn it off | `LLM002: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM002` on the command line |

ChatMemory holds the conversation. A singleton bean creates it once and every user writes into it, so A's question becomes B's context — cross-talk like this never shows up in load tests.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM002` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm002 -->

## What it looks like

A singleton `@Service` holding `private final ChatMemory chatMemory = MessageWindowChatMemory.withMaxMessages(20)`.

## How to fix

Keep memory per conversation: a `ChatMemoryProvider` keyed by a conversation id, used together with `MessageChatMemoryAdvisor`.
